assets.name: activity-wheel
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a single production-ready mobile UI shortcut icon, square composition, real transparent background.
Input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: existing navigation icons from the actual website. Create a new companion icon that looks like the SAME artist drew it. Match their chunky near-black plum outlines, simple rounded shapes, creamy ivory and pale lavender gradient fills, modest dusty-rose accents, crisp tiny white highlights, and a slightly extruded dark shadow below. Front-facing or very slight three-quarter view. This is a clean 2.5D cartoon game-menu icon, NOT a photorealistic render, not complex shiny gold illustration.
Composition: centered, one large compact readable silhouette occupying about 84% of the square, evenly padded. Must be immediately recognizable displayed at 78 px.
ABSOLUTE CONSTRAINT: NO text, letters, words, numbers, money amounts, currency symbols, logos, watermarks, banners, captions, labels, background tile, ground plane, scenery, or checkerboard. All labels are rendered separately in HTML. Background must have actual transparent alpha.
Subject: a lucky prize wheel. A bold upright circular wheel with eight simple wedges alternating cream, pale lavender and muted rose, a small round center hub, a small downward triangular pointer above, and a short rounded pedestal. Clean strong outline, no markings inside the blank wedges. Keep the wheel almost front-on and the pedestal unobtrusive.
